name.description: The team's name and its file's: a lowercase letter, then up to 23 of a-z, 0-9 and -; not main or chord

description.description: What the team is for, one line of at most 200 characters

agent.description: The runtime, as list_agents names it

model.description: A model id list_agents gives for the runtime; the runtime's own if left out

effort.description: An effort the runtime offers for that model, by its id, as list_agents lists them (`efforts`); the runtime's own if left out. One it does not take starts the agent on its own

mode.description: A mode id list_agents gives for the runtime: the permissions it works under, which the person approves; the runtime's own if left out

instructions.description: How the lead works: when it opens which member, what it does itself

lead.description: The lead, which opens the members, names who edits which files and reports to main

name.description: A lowercase letter, then up to 15 of a-z, 0-9 and -; unique, not main, chord or the team's name

role.description: What it does, one line of at most 80

agent.description: The runtime, as list_agents names it

model.description: A model id list_agents gives for the runtime; the runtime's own if left out

effort.description: An effort the runtime offers for that model, by its id, as list_agents lists them (`efforts`); the runtime's own if left out. One it does not take starts the agent on its own

mode.description: A mode id list_agents gives for the runtime: the permissions it works under, which the person approves; the runtime's own if left out

instructions.description: How it does its part, in full

body.description: How the team works, in markdown, which every agent of it reads: the steps, a "Who edits what" section (one writer per file, how members agree on files, that other runs of a team may work here too) and a "Reporting" section (when the lead writes to main)
